description: Software Factory inspector for the GitHub Copilot CLI and VS Code (Copilot and Local harnesses): audits each job when it ends (close, cancel or abandon — from the agent, a chat reply or your terminal), reports on session start, applies your finding replies, and keeps its own controls human-only. Native Copilot format (version 1, camelCase events); scripts read both payload shapes and write both output shapes (flat Copilot fields plus VS Code Local's hookSpecificOutput). No matchers. Each entry has `bash`, `powershell` and `command` (the same POSIX launcher as `bash`, for VS Code's Local harness). Each command starts with H=<plugin>:<hook>, so a timeout warning names the hook. Every launcher ends in exit 0: if node is missing or crashes, the inspector is off with a warning on stderr.

sessionStart.bash: H=inspector:session; R=$PLUGIN_ROOT; [ -n "$R" ] || R=$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT; [ -n "$R" ] || R=$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; case "$R" in [A-Za-z]:*) command -v wslpath >/dev/null 2>&1 && R=$(wslpath -u "$R" 2>/dev/null);; esac; case "$R" in *\\*) R=$(printf '%s' "$R" | tr '\\' '/');; esac; L=$FACTORY_USER_DIR; [ -n "$L" ] || L=$HOME/.factory; [ -f "$R/hooks/session-start.js" ] || { F=$(cat "$L/plugin-root" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$F" ] && R=$(dirname "$F")/factory-inspector; }; [ -f "$R/hooks/session-start.js" ] || { echo "[$H] hook script $R/hooks/session-start.js not found; hook skipped" >&2; exit 0; }; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { N=$(cat "$L/node-path" 2>/dev/null); [ -x "$N" ] && PATH=$(dirname "$N"):$PATH; for d in "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.volta/bin"; do command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || PATH=$d:$PATH; done; }; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[$H] node is not on PATH; inspector hooks are off" >&2; exit 0; }; node "$R/hooks/session-start.js" sessionStart || echo "[$H] hook failed (exit $?); allowed" >&2; exit 0
sessionStart.powershell: $h='inspector:session'; $r=$env:PLUGIN_ROOT; if (-not $r) { $r=$env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not $r) { $r=$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/session-start.js")) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[$h] hook script $r/hooks/session-start.js not found; hook skipped"); exit 0 }; if (-not (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[$h] node is not on PATH; inspector hooks are off"); exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/session-start.js" sessionStart; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[$h] hook failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE); allowed") }; exit 0
